final: WITH college_income AS (SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) AS college_total FROM income JOIN member ON member.member_id = income.link_to_member JOIN major ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major GROUP BY major.college), total_income AS (SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM income) SELECT college_income.college, college_income.college_total, CAST(college_income.college_total AS REAL) / total_income.total FROM college_income CROSS JOIN total_income WHERE total_income.total IS NOT NULL
